title: Streak and achievements
summary: A logging streak with freeze tokens, and badges for what was logged.

requirements.text: The streak counts consecutive days with anything logged; a day inside a multi-day fast counts.
Every `streak.freeze-every` straight days earn a freeze token, up to `streak.max-freezes` banked.
A banked freeze covers a missed day automatically.
The streak is shown in the Diary header and opens the achievements.
Achievements are derived from the database, so past history counts and a missed scan loses nothing.
Tiers of one counting badge (7, 30, 90 … days) show as a single row climbing to its next tier.
